Add your countdown to your iPhone for a lovely, app-like experience.

  1. 1
    Open this website in Safari.Use the hosted HTTPS link on your iPhone.
  2. 2
    Tap Share.The square with an upward arrow. It may be inside Safari’s More menu.
  3. 3
    Choose Add to Home Screen.Turn on “Open as Web App” if shown, then tap Add.

Just yours, right here.

There’s no app account and no tracking. Your date, name, holidays and PTO stay in this browser’s local storage. They don’t sync between devices. Clearing website data removes them. A Home Screen app may have separate storage, so check your details after installing.

Save a backup before changing devices. A backup contains your personal countdown details; keep it somewhere you trust.

Offline support becomes available after this app has loaded once on HTTPS or localhost.

Celebrations appear when you open the app; there are no background notifications.
